author: (Broderip, 1833)

note.en: A small winged murex (a typhis) about 3 cm long recorded once at 3 m at Cahuita. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Cahuita, 1998).
note.es: Un murex alado pequeño (un tifis) de unos 3 cm registrado una vez a 3 m en Cahuita. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Cahuita, 1998).

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Cahuita, 1998)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Cahuita, 1998).

marks.en: Small shell with three wing-like frills along its length and tube-like spines.
marks.es: Concha pequeña con tres alas o volantes a lo largo y tubos espinosos.
